operators.name: conv_transpose_forward

parameters.name: x
parameters.shape: same as reference step: [batch, in_channels, length]

parameters.name: weight
parameters.shape: same as reference step: [in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size]

returns.shape: same as reference step_001: [batch, out_channels, new_length]

semantics: 对应参考语句 x = self.conv_transpose(x)
执行 ConvTranspose1d 前向计算，使用 cuDNN，参数与参考模块一致：in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, stride, padding, output_padding
实际 bias 为 self.conv_transpose.bias（可 None，但此任务中非 None）
输入 x 形状 [batch, in_channels, length]，输出形状 [batch, out_channels, L_out]，其中 L_out = (length - 1) * stride - 2 * padding + kernel_size + output_padding
输出为连续张量

operators.name: layer_norm_forward

parameters.name: x
parameters.shape: same as reference step: [batch, out_channels, new_length]

returns.shape: same as reference step_002: [batch, out_channels, new_length]

semantics: 对应参考语句 x = self.layer_norm(x)
执行 LayerNorm 前向计算，归一化轴为 normalized_shape=(out_channels, new_length)，即对每个样本的最后两个维度求均值和方差
实际 affine 参数为 self.layer_norm.weight 和 self.layer_norm.bias，形状与 normalized_shape 相同
使用参考模块的 eps=1e-05
保持输入 dtype/device，输出为连续张量

operators.name: addcmul_forward

parameters.name: input
parameters.shape: same as reference step: [batch, out_channels, new_length]

parameters.name: tensor1
parameters.shape: same as reference step: [batch, out_channels, new_length]

parameters.name: tensor2
parameters.shape: same as reference step: [batch, out_channels, new_length]

returns.shape: same as reference step_003: [batch, out_channels, new_length]

semantics: 对应参考语句 x = torch.addcmul(x, v, w, value=1.0)
计算 output = input + value * tensor1 * tensor2，逐元素计算
三个输入形状相同，无广播
输出为连续张量
实际计算语义：对输入 x 执行 ConvTranspose1d 前向，使用模块参数 weight 和 bias，stride=2, padding=1, output_padding=1
实际计算语义：对 x 执行 LayerNorm，归一化轴为 (16, 12800)，使用 weight 和 bias，eps=1e-05
实际计算语义：x = x + 1.0 * v * w，逐元素计算
实际计算语义：返回最终的 x 张量
